Agathe gibt dir nach dem leeren Grab den: After the empty grave Agathe gives you the right key.
Agathe holt einen zweiten Schlüssel aus: Agathe fetches a second key from the mortuary. "The first one will turn up again. Everything turns up again here." This time she ties it to your wrist.

Agathes alter Schlüssel zum Seiteneingan: Agathe's old key to the side entrance of the Lamp Office. No key opens a friendly look.
Am Sicherungsseil hängt ein gebranntes H: A branded piece of wood with the number 17 hangs on the safety rope. Under the number it says "Raft Cemetery". It is a transport tag, not a name.
Am Sichtsteg liegt der Abdruck eines Rin: At the viewing jetty lies the impression of a ring. The lighthouse in the circle is missing a beam. Next to it sticks an old transport tag whose number can be checked separately.
The rod carries two rows of numbers. The first is cut deep, the second only painted on and lower. Someone made the pit smaller on paper than it is under the earth.
Auf der großen Karte wirken die Torfbrüc: On the big map the peat pits look like a clean patch. A pencil line connects the old pit to Raft 17. Above it: "Transfer completed."
Berichte Agathe vom Siegel und der Numme: Tell Agathe about the seal and the number 17.
Tell Jonas who the bride was.
Brandts Unterschrift steht unter der Ern: Brandt's signature stands under the renewal of lock C/17, dated twelve years ago. "Current order remains in force. No reopening without return of the seal." The paper proves the file was suppressed again. It says nothing about what Brandt knew of Marta's ghost.
Corvin richtet seine Ärmelschoner zum dr: Corvin straightens his sleeve protectors for the third time. "Information costs nothing. That's why it is given so reluctantly here."
Corvin schiebt eine saubere Seite unter: Corvin slides a clean page under the blotting sand. "The previous one isn't gone. Just underneath." He looks at you as if he himself didn't know whether that was an apology.
Corvin öffnet die Kasse für „Rückführung: Corvin opens the cash box for "return of official seals". "Seventy-five shillings. The ring stays here, Marta stays struck out." He pushes the receipt over to you. Your copy he cannot take from you.
The Office can buy the ring back.
Das Brautkleid bleibt still, während der: The wedding dress stays still while the peat beneath it rises. For two hundred years the seal has held on to a name. Now it lashes at the hand that wants to bring it back.
Das Floß liegt höher als die anderen. Di: The raft lies higher than the others. The hollow in the peat is neatly lined; no post was torn out. Whoever lay here was lifted, not taken by the water.
Das Floß schlägt leise gegen seine Vertä: The raft knocks softly against its mooring. Above the empty grave there is room for a name.
Das Glas ist innen beschlagen. Wenn du e: The glass is fogged on the inside. When you wipe it, the print reappears from the other side. There is no draught in the tunnel.
Das Lichtamt ließ Marta Vennicks Namen v: Two hundred years ago the Lamp Office had Marta Vennick's name erased to discredit her warning against unsupported peat cutting. Brandt later renewed the lock on the entry. This proves continued cover-up, not her involvement in the death back then.
Das Lichtamt ließ die Tote vom Friedhof: The Lamp Office had the dead woman taken from the cemetery back into the peat pits. The field "Name" is scraped off, the damaged lighthouse stamp intact. Next to it: "Lock entry C/17."
Das Lichtamt verwahrt die Überführung al: The Lamp Office keeps the transfer as an administrative case. Decide whether you protect Corvin or put pressure on him, and secure the two file sheets.
Das Seil führt ohne Abzweig zum Torfstic: The rope leads without a branch to the peat cutting. Every few steps a new peg stands next to an old one. Jonas never trusts the ground with the same spot twice.
Das Siegel springt. Marta öffnet die Han: The seal breaks. Marta opens her hand, and you can take the ring. She waits for your decision.
Das Siegel verschwindet in einer Schubla: The seal vanishes into a drawer, the coins into your hand. Corvin only crosses out the number, because the name has long been missing. You keep your knowledge. On Raft 17 the wood stays empty.
Das Wasser ist klar genug, um den Boden: The water is clear enough to see the bottom. No dress lies on the peat any more. From far above comes the creak of a mooring.
Lay the ring back in Marta's hand.
Der Anlegesteg ist mit einem Tau gesperr: The landing jetty is roped off. Jonas Peck at the peat cutting knows when Agathe receives visitors.
Der Bann ist gebrochen. Welche Wege blei: The spell is broken. What paths are left?
Der Eintrag und die Verfügung liegen vor: I have the entry and the order.
Der Hund legt sich hin. Als du blinzelst: The hound lies down. When you blink, there is only a warm heap of silt.
Der Kittel fällt in sich zusammen. Die L: The smock collapses in on itself. The pay packet stays closed.
Der Pförtner prüft deine Kleidung. „Nur: The porter checks your clothes. "Only Academy members registered for file inspection."
Der Stollen ist gesperrt. Jonas kennt ei: The tunnel is closed. Jonas knows a safe way in.
Der Torf hebt eine Gestalt im alten Arbe: The peat lifts a figure in an old work smock. In the breast pocket sits a pay packet without a name.
Der Wurm zieht sich in seinen Gang zurüc: The worm withdraws into its tunnel. The last thread tears with a sound like wet paper.
Die Braut hieß Marta Vennick und war Gru: The bride's name was Marta Vennick, and she was a pit surveyor. After her death two hundred years ago the Lamp Office had her name erased to discredit her warning against unsupported cutting.
Die Flamme faltet sich zusammen. Das Gla: The flame folds in on itself. The glass stays in the air a moment longer.
Die Moorbraut sieht dich an, und für ein: The moor bride looks at you, and for a breath you are as long alone as she is. -12 nerves.
Die Nummern sind vollständig, die Namen: The numbers are complete, the names are not. Under C/17 a rectangle has been scraped blank. Without Corvin's information you might take the difference for a printing error.
Die Schreibunterlage ist glatt, an einer: The desk pad is smooth; fine peat dust lies in one corner. The calendar holds appointments, not explanations. The chair is empty. The Lightmistress is working elsewhere today.
Die Stollenwand zieht einen Faden über d: The tunnel wall draws a thread across the passage. Behind it a maw opens, slowly, like a heavy door.
Die Streife soll verhindern, dass Holz o: The patrol is meant to stop wood without an official stamp from leaving the cemetery. The slip says nothing about who may scrape off names. The ink is dry at that spot.
Du folgst dem Seil zum Licht am Stollenm: You follow the rope to the light at the tunnel mouth. Behind you a drop falls, then none for a long time.
Du hast etwas im Stollen gesehen?: You saw something in the tunnel?
Du legst den Ring in ihre Hand, das gebr: You lay the ring in her hand, the broken seal facing down. The mud slowly closes. Jonas waits at the tunnel exit and gives you thirty shillings from the shared salvage fund. "Then at least we'll write down where she lies."
Du nennst Marta beim Namen. Der Ring zie: You call Marta by her name. The ring contracts, and the mud rises like a curtain. It is not Marta reaching for you. The seal wants to keep its number.
Du schneidest langsam, bis kein Buchstab: You carve slowly, until no letter gives way to the next. The ring stays beneath the tablet, and the raft sinks a hand's breadth deeper. On the wet wood lies a wreath of moor blossoms. Agathe gives you twenty shillings and leaves you alone with the name.
Ein Brautring mit dem alten Siegel des L: A wedding ring bearing the old seal of the Lamp Office. Its spell is broken. It belongs to Marta Vennick, not in a trader's crate.
Ein Hund aus Schlick schnuppert an deine: A hound made of silt sniffs at your footprints. Its collar is only the imprint of a collar.
Ein Paar kleine Stiefel steht auf einem: A pair of small boots stands on a grave, carefully filled with peat. Not everyone who is missing lies under their belongings. The name on the tablet is still legible.
A sign asks you to ring only once. Beneath it lie three applications to replace a clapper. The porter has placed his chair so that he sees none of them.
Ein Siegel im weichen Torf: A seal in the soft peat
Ein Streifen liegt zwischen zwei Torfzie: A strip lies between two peat bricks. The seam is set by hand, uneven and firm. Whatever the Office surveyed here, this dress was made for a person.
Ein Stück Stoff, zweihundert Jahre feuch: A piece of cloth, damp for two hundred years and yet intact. It smells of a room where someone is waiting.
Ein altes Bestatterschloss hält die Seit: An old undertaker's lock keeps the side door shut.
Ein hohler Zahn, in dessen Spitze Schlic: A hollow tooth with silt standing in its tip. The hound didn't need it for chewing.
Ein honigfarbener Splitter aus tiefem To: A honey-coloured splinter from deep peat. Inside lies a blossom no one knows in today's moor.
A pit lamp floats at eye level. Its glass turns towards you, though no handle holds it.
Eine Reihe Kerben zeigt die Höhe der Flö: A row of notches shows the height of the rafts in storms. Next to the last one: "If one is missing, look for the rope first. Not for a culprit."
Eine Tote wurde auf Anweisung des Lichta: On the Lamp Office's orders a dead woman was taken from Raft 17 back into the peat pits. The corresponding file was locked.
Erst Agathes Überführung prüfen, dann im: First check Agathe's transfer, then put on the Academy robe in the barge. Or use the side door.
Floß 17 trägt ein leeres Grab und ein ab: Raft 17 carries an empty grave and a scraped tablet. Two traces show whether the moor or a person took the dead woman away.
Gefahr ☠☠☠. Alte Stollen unter dem Moorr: Danger ☠☠☠. Old tunnels beneath the moor's edge. Jonas knows the dry entrance.
Grauer Faden aus einem Torfwurmgang. Tro: Grey thread from a peat worm's tunnel. Dry, it contracts; wet, it holds a whole plank.
Grünes Lampenglas ohne Schnittkante. Im: Green lamp glass without a cut edge. In the dark a shadow falls into it.
Hier sind die Schabspuren und die Quittu: Here are the scrape marks and the receipt.
Ich suche Überführung 17. Dein Name blei: I'm looking for transfer 17. Your name stays out of my copy.
Im Leichenhaus liegt ein Schein aus der: In the mortuary lies a slip from two hundred years ago: "Body back to the place it was found. Lock entry C/17." The Lamp Office seal has a broken beam. An undertaker has written beneath it: "Grave handed over empty, costs outstanding."
Im Sandkasten glitzern alte Tintenschupp: Old flakes of ink glitter in the sandbox. Here they don't only dry writing. They also keep its remains, neatly topped up.
Im schwarzen Wasser steht eine Frau im B: In the black water stands a woman in a wedding dress. Her hand lies open on the peat. She moves her lips, but the ring answers with your voice.
Jedes Tau hat fünf Knoten. Agathe erklär: Every rope has five knots. Agathe tells visitors it's for the five fingers a hand opens when saying goodbye. To the Office she calls it a safeguard against storms.
Jonas Peck hat eine unverwest gebliebene: Jonas Peck saw a bride who never decayed, wearing an official ring. Check his observation before you alarm Agathe Mulch.
Jonas hat das Amtssiegel und die Nummer: Jonas saw the official seal and the number 17.
Jonas hat sich nicht getäuscht. Neben ei: Jonas wasn't mistaken. Next to a narrow handprint lies the circle of a ring: a lighthouse, a broken beam. Further down in the pool metal gleams on the hand of a silent bride. You can't reach her from here.
Jonas klopft seine kalte Pfeife gegen de: Jonas taps his cold pipe against his boot. "In the moor everything keeps. Except the wages."
Jonas zieht dich am Sicherungsseil zurüc: Jonas pulls you back along the safety rope into the peat cutting. "You're allowed to be stupid once a day. That's enough for today." Your notes and quest items stay with you.
Lass Agathe die beiden Spuren vergleiche: Have Agathe compare the two traces.
Marta Vennick wartet seit zweihundert Ja: Marta Vennick has been waiting beneath the moor for two hundred years. Break the spell of her ring, then decide between name, rest or hush money.
Marta Vennick, Grubenvermesserin, starb: Marta Vennick, pit surveyor, died on the morning of her wedding two hundred years ago when the unsupported lower pit collapsed. She had reported the danger in writing. The Office ordered her name erased and her body returned to the moor, so that her petition would count as unattributable.
Marta Vennick, Grubenvermesserin. Gestor: Marta Vennick, pit surveyor. Died on the morning of her wedding two hundred years ago. Her warning against unsupported cutting was filed as an "unattributable petition" after the Lamp Office had her name erased. The dress was to be returned to her family. The receipt line stayed empty.
Marta Vennicks Namen ins Täfelchen schne: Carve Marta Vennick's name into the tablet.
Marta dreht die Handfläche nach oben. Du: Marta turns her palm upward. You can give the ring back and keep the name in your notebook. Then she stays beneath the moor, and no new tablet will hang on the raft.
Moorblüten aus einem Grab, das endlich e: Moor blossoms from a grave that finally bears a name. The wreath holds your thoughts fast and your feet heavy.
After Act III: talk to Jonas.
Check the ring impression at the viewing jetty.
Ring verkaufen. Auf Martas Namen verzich: Sell the ring. Give up Marta's name.
Sie hier lassen und den Ring zurückgeben: Leave her here and give the ring back.
Stelle dich der Moorbraut am Brautbecken: Face the moor bride at the Bridal Pool.
Täfelchen setzen und den Ring daran befe: Set the tablet and fasten the ring to it.
Unter der hellen Schicht liegen gerade S: Under the pale layer lie straight cuts. The number 17 is still on the back. The hook above it is old, so the scraped name vanished while the tablet was already hanging at the grave.
Vertäute Gräber vor Pfahldorf. Agathe Mu: Moored graves off the stilt village. Agathe Mulch keeps the names above water.
Vor zwölf Jahren: „Geltende Ordnung blei: Twelve years ago: "Current order remains in force. No reopening without return of the seal." Below it Ilse Brandt's signature. The original order is two hundred years old. Brandt did not issue it, but she decided to let it stand.
Wie komme ich ins Lichtamt?: How do I get into the Lamp Office?
Wie liegt das Floß jetzt?: How does the raft lie now?
Wo muss ich jetzt suchen?: Where do I have to look now?
Wähle bei Agathe einen Abschluss: Täfelc: Choose an ending with Agathe: set the tablet, return the ring to the moor, or sell it at the Lamp Office.
Zeig das Register, sonst nenne ich dich: Show me the register, or I'll name you publicly as an accomplice.
Zum Amtsgebäude. Haupteingang mit angezo: To the office building. Main entrance wearing the Academy robe, or the side door with the undertaker's key.
Go back to the raft cemetery.
Zurück an den Fundort: Back to where she was found
Über dem Grubenwasser steht grünes Licht: Green light hangs above the pit water. Jonas has marked the edge with chalk: "Keep the lamp low, head high." The safe way leads around the outside. No smell warns you of the gas.
„Archiv, Register C. Kartenraum, Fortgel: "Archive, register C. Map room, continuation folder." Corvin now speaks so quietly that you only hear the initial letters. They are enough.
„Dann schreib, was du findest. Nicht, we: "Then write what you find. Not who showed you the drawer." Corvin pushes the catalogue over. "Marriage register C, sheet 17. The continuation is in the map room. You need both sheets, otherwise it looks like an old mistake."
„Der Pförtner am Haupteingang lässt die: "The porter at the main entrance lets the Academy robe through. Put it on in the barge; in a bundle it won't help you much." Agathe raises her key. "Or take the side door in the Upper Town. Both ways are guarded. A key doesn't make you invisible."
„Du kannst das Täfelchen auf Floß 17 bef: "You can fasten the tablet onto Raft 17. Then Marta has a place with us again." Agathe puts the knife down. "Or you give her the ring back at the Bridal Pool and leave her there. Corvin will take it too, for money and silence. You only decide for good at the place itself."
„Du würdest meinen Namen nehmen, um eine: "You'd take my name to give another one back?" Corvin points at the catalogue. "C, sheet 17. Continuation in the map room." Then he pulls the alarm cord. You escape through the side corridor into the Upper Town. You've memorised both locations.
„Eine Braut, unten im alten Bruch. Nicht: "A bride, down in the old pit. Not bones, a whole woman in a dress. On her ring sits the lighthouse in a circle." Jonas shows you the way on a peat brick. "She laid her hand on the soft jetty. You can look there without going down to her."
„Erst der Abdruck am Sichtsteg und die F: "First the impression at the viewing jetty and the ferry tag next to it. Agathe knows the numbers of her rafts." Jonas tightens his belt. "For the files you go to the Lamp Office. For the bride you go back under the earth. Don't mix them up."
„Es liegt tiefer“, sagt Agathe. „So, als: "It lies deeper," says Agathe. "As if it were finally carrying someone." She pushes a blossom from the jetty onto the raft. No one counts them.
"Straight knife cuts, dry ink. Someone had the name scraped off and the body taken back into the moor." Agathe takes a key from a black ribbon. "Undertakers used to have to use the side door. We weren't allowed to get the great hall wet. Corvin keeps the register today."
„Lampen während der Pause abdecken. Unbe: "Cover lamps during breaks. Unlit tables are not considered unoccupied." In the margin someone has drawn a tiny sleeper.
„Liegeplatz für Verstorbene: unbefristet: "Mooring for the deceased: unlimited. Applications for extension are not accepted." Someone has written "finally" underneath.
„Marta Vennick, Grubenvermesserin.“ Daru: "Marta Vennick, pit surveyor." Nothing is entered below. Agathe has left room for what you will never learn.
„Marta Vennick“, wiederholt Jonas. „Zwei: "Marta Vennick," Jonas repeats. "Two hundred years, and every year the Office made a clean copy." He gives you his saved wages. "At the Bridal Pool the ring holds the mud together. You have to break the spell before you can carry it. After that no one can force you to give up her name."
„Siebzehn. Das leere Grab.“ Agathe greif: "Seventeen. The empty grave." Agathe reaches for an old cash bag. "The twelve shillings are for the search, not for the dead woman. She owes us nothing." She points at the raft behind the two gravestones. "Look at the wood and at the receipt in the mortuary. The moor doesn't issue receipts."
„Stützbalken beantragt. Stützbalken vert: "Support beams requested. Support beams postponed. Survey repeated." The last line is only a long stroke of ink. The cover survived the collapse better than its writer.
